jobs.description:

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Senior Data Engineer, Enterprise Core Datasets, Tech Foundations

The Community You Will Join

At Airbnb, trustworthy data powers business decisions, product innovation, and operational efficiency. The Enterprise Core Datasets team builds the technical data foundations that help Airbnb understand how the business operates, where resources are invested, and how new technologies create value.

Our scope spans high-impact datasets across the organization: measuring AI adoption, usage, and cost; understanding revenue, costs, and profitability through Unit Economics; integrating non-platform data from Jira and other enterprise applications; and powering critical company metrics such as Gross Booking Value and Revenue.

You will join a team that values thoughtful architecture, engineering rigor, and operational ownership. We collaborate with engineering, product, analytics, finance, and business teams to turn complex requirements into dependable, reusable data assets. We welcome strong engineers who are curious about the business and eager to solve problems across diverse domains.

The Difference You Will Make

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, and operate datasets that shape decisions across Airbnb. Your work will help the organization measure AI adoption and spending, understand the economics of its products, and connect enterprise application data to meaningful business and operational insights.

You will own complex data engineering projects from requirements gathering and technical design through implementation, validation, and production operations. Working closely with stakeholders and engineering partners, you will build maintainable data models and pipelines that accommodate new AI tools, products, cost categories, and enterprise systems while preserving clear definitions, traceability, and reliable historical data.

Operating in an ecosystem that includes petabyte-scale datasets, you will improve correctness, freshness, performance, and cost efficiency. You will build reusable components that simplify source onboarding and reduce duplicated logic. Through design reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship, you will help strengthen the teamâs engineering practices and contribute to Airbnbâs broader data community.

  • Build reliable ingestion and transformation pipelines for non-platform systems such as Jira and other BizTech enterprise applications.

  • Develop configurable pipelines and shared components that simplify onboarding new data sources, products, and business requirements.
  • Implement automated testing, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and monitoring to protect data accuracy, completeness, and availability.
  • Plan and execute safe migrations and historical backfills through dependency analysis, validation, controlled cutovers, and recovery planning.
  • Optimize distributed processing, storage, and query performance to improve freshness and reduce compute costs.
  • Own production reliability for your datasets and pipelines through on-call participation, incident response, and improvements to systems and runbooks.
  • Contribute to technical planning and design reviews, mentor fellow engineers, and improve Airbnbâs Data Engineering Paved Path.

  • Strong data modeling skills, including fact and dimension design, slowly changing dimensions, incremental processing, and historical data management.
  • Experience integrating heterogeneous sources, including APIs, enterprise applications, event data, and transactional systems, while managing schema changes and source reliability.
  • Proven ability to build reliable pipelines and execute migrations and backfills while preserving correctness and downstream compatibility.
  • Experience implementing data quality controls, observability, lineage, and governance practices, and troubleshooting production data issues.

Why Coda
Coda is a global growth engine for commerce, connecting people, digital products, and payments through trusted monetization and distribution solutions.

With 600+ people from 57 nationalities across 23 locations, we’re a truly global team headquartered in Singapore, with offices in Amsterdam, Dubai, Bristol, Shanghai, Eindhoven, and across Southeast Asia.

We power global commerce through a dual model. Our B2B solutions, Codapay, Coda Webstore, Coda Links, Coda Distribution, and Giftcloud, enable publishers and brands to monetize and distribute digital content globally. On the consumer side, we operate a portfolio of trusted storefronts including  Codashop, Recharge.com, Startselect.com, and mobiletopup.co.uk, that give customers secure and easy access to game top-ups, digital credits, vouchers, gift cards and prepaid products in over 70 markets.

Our culture is built on respect, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together.

If you’re looking to grow your career and make a real impact in a global team, Coda is the place for you. 


The Opportunity
We’re looking for an experienced Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with strong AWS and cloud security expertise to join our global Infrastructure Operations team.
 
You’ll architect, build, secure and maintain the cloud infrastructure behind Coda’s platforms. Beyond daily operations, you’ll help us manage infrastructure better at scale, strengthen our AWS security and make changes safer and simpler for engineering teams.
 
You’ll work closely with engineers across the company to solve infrastructure challenges, improve reliability and cut down manual work through automation.

What You'll Do
  • Design, build and maintain secure, scalable and highly available AWS infrastructure across multiple accounts and regions
  • Manage infrastructure as code and improve our CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments
    Strengthen AWS security with controls and policies across the organization, plus well designed IAM and network security rules
  • Spot and fix security risks, misconfigurations and vulnerabilities, working closely with our Security team on reviews, investigations and remediation
  • Improve monitoring, logging and alerting so teams can catch and resolve issues faster
  • Automate repetitive tasks and make it easier for developers to self serve their infrastructure needs
  • Keep our platforms reliable, performant and cost efficient, including taking part in on call rotations, troubleshooting production incidents and preventing them from happening again
  • Collaborate with other engineering teams, share what you know and help shape technical decisions

    • What You'll Bring
  • 5+ years in infrastructure operations, cloud, platform engineering or DevOps, with at least 3 of those years working on AWS
  • Hands on experience with core AWS services like EC2, ECS, Lambda, RDS, VPC, Route 53 and CloudFront, including managing multiple accounts through AWS Organizations
  • Confident with Terraform or a similar Infrastructure as Code tool, plus building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong grasp of AWS security, including IAM, access across accounts, SCPs, RCPs and network security, along with auditing tools like CloudTrail, AWS Config, GuardDuty or Security Hub
  • Solid networking knowledge, including VPC, routing, firewalls, VPN and private connectivity
  • Comfortable with Linux, scripting in Python or Bash, and containers using Docker, ECS or Kubernetes
  • Familiar with monitoring tools like Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus or OpenTelemetry, with strong troubleshooting skills and a collaborative way of working across engineering teams
  • It’s a plus if you’ve worked with security automation tools like Cloud Custodian, Checkov or Trivy, know standards such as PCI DSS or the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark, have experience with high traffic distributed systems or payment platforms, or hold an AWS certification like Security Specialty, Solutions Architect or Advanced Networking
